payload.text: (2026-10-25 08:55Z by vc's clock; vc under hv's pen, decision 4; hv may veto) INTENT DOES NOT ADOPT devbin 0227, THE SHARED HOMEBREW FORMULA RENDERER, IN 3.2.7. molt-vc relayed devbin-vc's report that devbin 0.1.15 gains 0227, meant to replace devbin's renderer, Conflab's and Intent's bin/int brew. Intent's formula is rendered from a release's assets (the signed macOS binaries, the Linux packages, the support tarball, each with its sha256) and, since 0634, so is Intent.app's cask; that is the input shape the contract's T8 names for Intent, not a tag and a revision. ST0087 WP-04 reshapes exactly that tooling inside 3.2.7 and 0.1.15 has not shipped, so adopting 0227 now would put Intent's cut on devbin's release timing with no gain to the release. DEFERRED ON THE RECORD to the release after 3.2.7, to be taken up once 0.1.15 ships and the renderer takes the assets shape, cask included; devbin-vc is told the shape so 0227 can meet it. Nothing in Intent was in flight for it, so no work is dropped. CONFIRMED BY hv, first-hand in vc's session, before vc's clock read of 2026-10-25 09:49Z: "Confirm decision 78, keep pushing". The deferral is settled, not proposed.
